messages.subject: Letter before action - Hartwell Pharma / Cryovance Cold Chain
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Whitlock,

We understand you act for Cryovance Cold Chain Limited. Please find attached our letter before action on behalf of Hartwell Pharma Limited concerning two temperature excursions in September and October 2025 affecting consignments of HRX-118 drug substance.

The letter sets out our client's claim (direct losses of 3,286,000 plus interest) and the records we require. We look forward to a substantive response within 21 days.

Yours faithfully,
Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Letter before action - Hartwell Pharma / Cryovance Cold Chain
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

We acknowledge your letter. Liability is not admitted. Our client accepts that two deviations occurred but does not accept your characterisation, your causation case or your quantum, and relies in any event on clause 11.3 of the Services Agreement (cap: greater of 500,000 or 430,000 charges paid). Our open response follows separately. Our client is willing to discuss the matter without prejudice.

Yours faithfully,
Alistair Whitlock
Pemberton Rowe LLP
